records.name: Hackmeister Stückwerk
records.biography_en: Divides the world into suitable portions and other people's problems. His board divides HyperNorm supplies into proper portions and suspicious leftovers. A dissonant card asks who decided the serving size. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Zuständigkeit wurde portionsgerecht abgelegt.

variant_notes.note_en: Divides the world into suitable portions and other people's problems.

records.name: Wurstmeisterin Ringfest
records.biography_en: Brings every loose end together and ties it too firmly. Her tied HyperNorm sausage loop has no loose end for a dissonant card to grasp. It finds an opening in the knot instead. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Einigkeit ist an mehreren Stellen abgebunden.

variant_notes.note_en: Brings every loose end together and ties it too firmly.

records.name: Fleischwart Grammgenau
records.biography_en: Knows the exact weight of a decision before knowing what it is. His scales weigh HyperNorm parcels before their contents can cause disagreement. A dissonant card asks how much fairness ought to weigh. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Gewicht steht fest. Der Entschluss schwankt.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows the exact weight of a decision before knowing what it is.

records.name: Metzgerin Schnittstelle
records.biography_en: Keeps her edges sharper than the explanations from upstairs. Her honing steel keeps HyperNorm distinctions sharp enough to satisfy inspection. A dissonant card suggests that a clean division can still hurt feelings. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Erklärung benötigt dringend einen Abziehstahl.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps her edges sharper than the explanations from upstairs.

records.name: Proteinwart Zellteilung
records.biography_en: Is waiting for the product to decide what it would like to have been. His sealed HyperNorm protein cartridge contains a product approved before its category was agreed. A dissonant card asks it what it prefers. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Zellteilung wartet auf eine passende Abteilung.

variant_notes.note_en: Is waiting for the product to decide what it would like to have been.

records.name: Orbitalfleischer Reststück
records.biography_en: Makes six fair portions from a rule written for five. His little press makes HyperNorm rations conform to one authorized shape. A dissonant card leaves a corner for a late arrival. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Gerechtigkeit erhält eine einheitliche Verpackung.

variant_notes.note_en: Makes six fair portions from a rule written for five.
